Marico acquires 51% stake in Bonorizon Consumer Ventures for ₹35 crore
Adgully Bureau
| 1 week ago
Views: 840
Add Adgully as preferred on
Your browser does not support the audio element.
Marico Limited has signed definitive agreements to acquire a 51% equity stake and voting rights in Mumbai-headquartered Bonorizon  Consumer Ventures Private Limited for a cash consideration of up to ₹35 crore. Disclosed in a regulatory filing on November 6, 2026, under SEBI LODR regulations, the strategic venture includes Bonorizon's wholly-owned subsidiary, Bonorizon Consumer Ventures LLC, and is slated for completion within 90 days subject to customary closing conditions.
The acquisition aligns with Marico's global  business strategy to accelerate its international digital growth engine and strengthen its positioning as a multinational FMCG enterprise. Bonorizon, incorporated on October 22, 2026, operates across  consumer products and fast-moving consumer goods segments, with the new venture structured to leverage cross-border capabilities and scale commercial opportunities across international markets.
Under the terms of the transaction, no prior regulatory or government approvals are required to complete the initial 51% primary subscription. Furthermore, Marico holds the right to acquire the remaining 49% equity stake in Bonorizon after three years, with final valuation and consideration contingent upon milestone achievements and agreed contractual terms.
